# The Sun-Pyre Witch-Courts — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **FAITH** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Pyre-Dice:** Command Phase: roll 1 D6 and bank it as a Pyre-Die (keep the result). Also bank 1 when a friendly unit is destroyed. Maximum 3 banked. Once per activation, before rolling, you may replace ONE of your own Hit, Wound, ARM-save or Charge dice with a banked die. Pyre-Dice are never used on the opponent's rolls.

**Gamble — Martyr's Pyre** *(risk: resource)*: Once per battle, when a unit activates, spend ALL banked Pyre-Dice (minimum 2): its weapons gain [SHREDDING WOUNDS] and +1 Damage this activation. The bank is empty afterwards.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Pyre-Dice* — One replaced die per activation (~1 in 10 dice). · *Martyr's Pyre* — Once per battle on one unit.

## Detachment — Burning Rose

*Flamers forward: close the distance, burn the objectives.*

**Detachment rule:** Searing Purgation: [SCORCH] weapons gain +1 PEN. Once per round, one [SCORCH] attack against a unit on an objective also inflicts D3 Fatal Wounds on a 5+.

**Enhancements**
- **Ember of the First Pyre** (+15 pts, Canoness of the Pyre): +1 Damage to melee attacks on a round she charged.
- **Ash-Crown** (+10 pts, Grand Inquisitrix): The attached unit gets +1 PEN with ranged weapons.

**Stratagems**
- **Purging Flame** (1 CP) — *A unit with [SCORCH] weapons is selected to Shoot:* Re-roll its Wound rolls this activation.
- **Wall of Fire** (1 CP) — *An enemy unit declares a Charge against a unit with [SCORCH] weapons:* That unit's Retaliation Strike is made with one [SCORCH] weapon instead (hits automatically).
- **Fan the Flames** (1 CP) — *A friendly unit is destroyed:* Bank 2 Pyre-Dice instead of 1 (max 3).

## Detachment — Penitent Host

*Bleed for it: chipped squads get deadlier, so the opponent must finish what they start.*

**Detachment rule:** Blood of Martyrs: units below Starting Strength (or damaged, for single models) get +1 to Hit; below Half-Strength they also get +1 to Wound.

**Enhancements**
- **Scourge of Contrition** (+15 pts, Confessor-Firebrand): Friendly units within 6″ get +1 to Wound in melee on a round they charged.
- **Martyr's Shroud** (+15 pts, Canoness of the Pyre): The bearer has UNYIELDING 5+.

**Stratagems**
- **Final Absolution** (1 CP) — *A friendly Class 1–2 unit is destroyed in melee:* Before removal, its surviving models fight once more.
- **Unbroken Faith** (1 CP) — *A unit would become Rattled:* It is not Rattled.
- **Rush to Martyrdom** (1 CP) — *A unit below Starting Strength declares a Charge:* +2″ to the Charge roll.

## Detachment — Witch-Hunter Tribunal

*Hunt the leaders and casters, ignore the rest.*

**Detachment rule:** Sentence of the Court: before the battle mark 2 enemy units (at least 1 must be a Leader or [PSYCHIC / ARCANE] unit if possible). Your attacks against Marked units re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and gain [PRECISION]. When a Marked unit is destroyed, bank 1 Pyre-Die.

**Enhancements**
- **Seal of the Tribunal** (+10 pts, Grand Inquisitrix): The attached unit re-rolls Wound rolls of 1.
- **Null-Lantern** (+10 pts, Null-Maiden Warden): Null Aura range becomes 9″ and also applies to Fatal Wounds from spells (ignored on 5+).

**Stratagems**
- **Interrogate** (1 CP) — *A unit ends a Fight action engaged with a Marked unit:* Gain 1 CP (once per battle).
- **Burn the Witch** (1 CP) — *A unit targets a Marked [PSYCHIC / ARCANE] unit:* Its weapons gain [SCORCH] and +1 Damage.
- **Sentence Passed** (2 CP) — *Command Phase:* Move one Mark to a new enemy unit.
